title: HubPro
features:
OPEN HUB: Right-Ctrl

Hub Pro - Quality of Life Auto-Farm Script This is an open-source, highly configurable Quality of Life (QoL) script designed to make your grinding experience much easier. It is highly recommended to use this on private servers.

Disclaimer: There are currently some known bugs when trying to run multiple overlapping functions at the same time, but they work perfectly when used independently.

⚙️ Key Features & Setup Instructions:

Auto-Craft (Minigame): To set this up, hover your mouse over the right corner of the "Craft" button and press "Delete" on your keyboard to mark the pill pick-up position.

Important:* This is the only function that requires the game window to be active and on-screen. For all other functions, you can alt-tab and do other things while the script farms in the background.

Auto-Collect (Herbs/Chests): You "must" travel to the Forest map "before" activating the collection script, otherwise it will not work properly.

Background Farming: Instant Alchemy, Auto-Breakthrough, and Auto-Economy run completely passively.

🛠️ Tested & Supported Executors:

Xeno / Velocity

tips: The silver -> gold -> spirit stone functions depend on you having completed the route completely.
